official: 東京都板橋区幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園の認定の要件を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 議案の審査状況（令和8年第3回定例会）

name: 認定こども園に犯罪事実確認を追加
summary: 現在の条例に、児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための規定を加えます。認定こども園の設置者に、子どもと接する一部の職員の犯罪事実確認などを求めます。施行日は2026年12月25日です。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等を防ぎ、発生した場合に子どもを保護するための措置を定める
設置者に、対象となる職員の犯罪事実確認などを義務付ける
who: 幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園の設置者
認定こども園で子どもと接する一部の職員
認定こども園に通う子ども
why: 法律の施行などに伴い、対象となる職員の犯罪事実確認などに関する規定を加えるためと、区は説明しています。

notes: ai [error] who/fact: 「認定こども園の設置者」 → 原文の対象は「幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園」の設置者です。要約ではこの限定がなく、幼保連携型も対象に含む表現になっています。

en.name: Adds criminal record checks at certified childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance of Itabashi City, Tokyo, Establishing Requirements for Certifying Certified Childcare Centers Other Than Integrated Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care
en.summary: Adds provisions to the current ordinance to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts. It requires operators of certified childcare centers to check the criminal records of certain staff members who have contact with children, among other things. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Set out measures to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, and to protect children if such acts occur
Require operators to check the criminal records of covered staff members, among other things
who: Operators of certified childcare centers other than integrated centers for early childhood education and care
Certain staff members who have contact with children at certified childcare centers
Children who attend certified childcare centers
en.why: The ward says it is adding provisions on criminal record checks, among other things, for covered staff members in connection with the law taking effect and other developments.
